chmod +x gradlew
sed -r 's/VERSION_NAME=\$version/VERSION_NAME=3.2.7/' -i app/version.properties
sed -r 's/int vcode = Integer.*/int vcode = 1873545/' -i app/build.gradle

git clone -b v0.2.8 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-realigned.apk
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*realigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
